name: Curacao
headline: Curacao: +5.0% growth in 2024, 2.6% inflation
sections: Curacao is a $3.6 billion economy (2024), the world's 181st-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +5.0% in 2024, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $33K at purchasing-power parity (2024), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 2.9% of GDP (2024).
Consumer prices rose 2.6% in 2019, broadly within typical target ranges, up from −0.0% in 2016.
